28.UNEMPLOYED YOUTH EMPLOYMENT GENERATION PROGRAMME  
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme  
Under 
“Unemployment 
Youth 
Employment 
Generation Programme”, the margin amount of 5% 
of the loan amount to be paid by the Differently 
Abled beneficiaries is borne by the government. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria  
National Identity Card for the Differently Abled, 
Age should be 18 – 45 years, terms and conditions 
of District Industries Centre to be fulfilled. 
3. 
Whether form of application 
is prescribed  
Yes. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished  
National identity card for the differently abled, 
educational certificates.  
5. 
Officer to whom the 
application is to be submitted  
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer / District 
Industries Center  
6. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Director (Placement), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the  
Differently Abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar Salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
